```
  async calendarAdd(item, agent) {
    const p = await this.resolvePaths(agent)
    const entries = this.parseCalendar(this.state.calendarText || await this.readTextSafe(p.calendarPath))
    entries.push({
      date: item.date || todayStr(), done: !!item.done, time: item.time || '--:--',
      quadrant: item.quadrant || '未分类', title: String(item.title || '').trim(), note: String(item.note || '').trim(),
    })
    const body = this.renderCalendar(entries)
    await this.writeFullRaw(p.calendarPath, body)
    this.state.calendarText = body; this.state.loadedAt = Date.now()
    return '已加入日历: ' + item.date + ' ' + (item.time || '') + ' ' + item.title + ' (' + (item.quadrant || '未分类') + ')'
```

title: [Bug][P2][F26] Python 文档 token 双重特殊包装与满块截断导致正文丢 token
body:
本轮审计编号：**F26**；分级：P2。确认基线：upstream main `13f980ac3e199bbe4c7a488bb493f278c7d8017f`（v3.2.7，2026-10-02 拉取）。

## 触发与实际行为

worker 对满 token 文档块执行 build_doc_ids 再 encode_ids。

build_doc_ids 添加 prefix/suffix 并截正文，encode_ids 再包装一次；下一块按原 chunk 步长推进，截掉 token 永久跳过。

## 直接源码证据

[python/m7_embedding_v1.py:164](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-auto-memory/blob/13f980ac3e199bbe4c7a488bb493f278c7d8017f/python/m7_embedding_v1.py#L164)

```
    def build_doc_ids(self, chunk_ids, max_total=512):
        """Wrap chunk token ids with the model's special tokens exactly once,
        capping total length at the XLM-R position limit (audit P0/P1)."""
        prefix, suffix = self._specials()
        budget = max_total - len(prefix) - len(suffix)
        body = list(chunk_ids)[:max(0, budget)]
        return list(prefix) + body + list(suffix)

    def encode_ids(self, ids_list, batch_size=8):
        torch = self._torch
        prefix, suffix = self._specials()
```

## 预期与回归验收

正文分块预留 specials，所有正文 token 恰好覆盖一次；query/document 只包装一次；策略身份升级使旧缓存失效。
